_comment: LONG-WATER-POLISH. Runtime-only local bank palette, split from terrain_playground.json because that broad file fingerprints the terrain and vegetation bakes. The R6 landform and scatter stay byte-for-byte unchanged. This rectangle covers river-course stations 4-6 and stops west of Old Mill Crossing; the shader additionally requires real rock texture weight, so meadow tops and water remain untouched. Two noise-mixed tints break the production review's uniform pale steep-face value without opening a crossing or changing collision. All values are tunable after fresh capture; strength 0 restores the retained R6 look.
